## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 751 reads during 488 hours of grading activity. The recorded throughput was 1.5 reads per hour. This provides the workload measure for the review period and indicates the volume processed against the hours available.

The workload was reviewed in relation to the established session pattern. No change to that pattern was recorded as part of this review.

## Quality

A sample of 56 reads was checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 82.1 per cent. This result records the level of consistency identified in the checked sample.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The workload and quality information should be retained with the relevant review records for reference.
